# Open PDF Editor

> Free, open-source (MIT) desktop PDF editor for Windows, macOS and Linux. It edits the PDF itself instead of drawing overlays: retype existing text, redact for real, fill and build forms, run OCR offline and sign with a certificate. Everything runs locally; there is no account and no upload.

## Features

- Edit existing text in place, matching its font, size and color; move, resize, recolor or delete text, images and vector graphics
- Redaction that removes text, graphics, image pixels, comments, links and form fields under the marks; "Sanitize" strips metadata, attachments, JavaScript and hidden layers
- Hand-drawn or typed signatures, and certificate signatures (.p12/.pfx, RSA or ECDSA, PAdES B-B); verifies signatures on files it opens
- Offline OCR (text recognition) for scanned pages
- Fill every form field type, add new fields, flatten on save
- Reorder, rotate, insert, merge, extract and split pages
- Annotations, watermarks, page numbers, AES-256 password protection
- Free alternative to Adobe Acrobat for everyday editing, including on Linux
